mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT p.id, p.permission_name, p.permission_code, p.description, p.created_at, p.updated_at FROM sys_permission p JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON p.id = rp.permission_id JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rp.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT p.id, p.permission_name, p.permission_code, p.description, p.created_at, p.updated_at FROM sys_permission p JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE rp.role_id = #{roleId} ORDER BY p.id
SELECT id, permission_name, permission_code, description, created_at, updated_at FROM sys_permission ORDER BY id
SELECT id, permission_name, permission_code, description, created_at, updated_at FROM sys_permission WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, permission_name, permission_code, description, created_at, updated_at FROM sys_permission WHERE permission_code = #{permissionCode} LIMIT 1
